OntoSage Conversational Building Vocabulary (OCBV)

Overview

OCBV is additive to Brick. It declares only ontosage: and hbco: terms and never alters the meaning of any brick: term; where it touches the physical building it references Brick classes as property ranges and aligns to external standards with SKOS mapping properties only. Load it alongside a Brick model to make that building answerable in plain language. v2.0.0 consolidates the former OCBV capability schema and the HBCO conversation ontology into this single file and adds stakeholder-role and standards-alignment modules.

@prefix bot: <https://w3id.org/bot#> .
@prefix brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#> .
@prefix dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/> .
@prefix hbco: <http://ontosage.org/hbco#> .
@prefix ontosage: <http://ontosage.org/capabilities#> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix rec: <https://w3id.org/rec#> .
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> .
@prefix sosa: <http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/> .
@prefix vann: <http://purl.org/vocab/vann/> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
ontosage:AVEquipment a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "AV / teaching equipment"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Projector, display, lecture-capture, microphone or hybrid-conferencing rig serving a space. 94 of the supervisors' questions depend on knowing whether the teaching kit in a room works BEFORE the class starts."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf brick:Equipment .
ontosage:AccessibleToilet a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Accessible toilet"@en ;
rdfs:comment "A toilet built for wheelchair users: both a toilet facility and an accessibility feature, so a question about either finds it."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf ontosage:AccessibilityFeature,
ontosage:ToiletFacility .
ontosage:AirQualityIndex a ontosage:Measurand ;
rdfs:label "air quality index"@en ;
ontosage:bandSource "US EPA AQI runs 0-500." ;
ontosage:physicalMax 500 ;
ontosage:physicalMin 0 ;
ontosage:physicalUnit "index" ;
ontosage:typicalDecimals 0 ;
ontosage:typicalMax 150 ;
ontosage:typicalMin 0 ;
rdfs:comment "A composite INDEX, not a concentration. Naming it separately is the point: a stream carrying an index cannot be reported in ppm, and the 0-150 values written against 174 CO2 sensors were on this scale."@en .
ontosage:Alarm_Group a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Alarm group"@en ;
rdfs:comment "A named set of alarms handled together. Deliberately a brick:Collection and NOT a brick:Alarm: a group of alarms is not itself an alarm, and typing it as one would let it match queries asking for active alarms."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf brick:Collection .
ontosage:AssemblyPoint a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Fire assembly point"@en ;
ontosage:layTerms "assembly point",
"assembly points",
"fire assembly point",
"muster point",
"muster points",
"muster station",
"where do i assemble",
"where do we assemble" ;
rdfs:comment "Where people gather after evacuating. An Amenity subclass so 'where is the muster point' is located like any other place — but a SAFETY place, so an instance is only ever a transcription of what the building itself publishes. A position nobody published must be left unrecorded: sending people to the wrong side of a building during an evacuation is the worst answer this vocabulary could produce."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf ontosage:Amenity ;
skos:example "\"where do we assemble?\" -> the assembly point the building's evacuation procedure names." .

ontosage:Contract a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Contract"@en ;
ontosage:layTerms "agreement",
"agreements",
"contract",
"contracts",
"framework",
"maintained by",
"maintenance contract",
"maintenance contractor",
"service agreement",
"service provider",
"service providers",
"serviced by",
"supplier",
"who looks after",
"who maintains",
"who services" ;
rdfs:comment "A service, maintenance or supply agreement with a provider, over a term, covering a named scope. Distinct from Warranty: a contract is bought, a warranty accompanies an asset — they have different owners and routinely disagree, which should be REPORTED rather than resolved."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf ontosage:IntervalRecord ;
skos:example "who maintains the lifts and until when? -> Contract whose coveredScope names the lift asset." .
ontosage:CoordinationFunction a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Emergency coordination function"@en ;
ontosage:layTerms "activation",
"are we ready for an incident",
"coordination",
"coordination function",
"emergency coordination",
"emergency coordinator",
"emergency coordinators",
"emergency response role",
"emergency response roles",
"evacuation control",
"incident command",
"manual fallback",
"operational period",
"roll call",
"who is on call" ;
rdfs:comment "One coordination function for one operational period: its accountable role, primary system and that system's state, the approved fallback, the activation criterion and whether that criterion is evidenced as met. UNKNOWN IS A FIRST-CLASS STATE. In an incident, 'we have not established whether this is met' and 'this is not met' lead to different decisions, and a register collapsing them into one empty cell would be actively dangerous -- so criterionState carries an explicit unknown, and a row without an evidence reference cannot be recorded as met. The approved fallback sits beside the function it replaces, because a fallback that must be looked up elsewhere during an incident is not a fallback."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf ontosage:Record ;
skos:example "which coordination systems are ready, degraded or unavailable, and what fallback applies? -> CoordinationFunction for the current period; read systemState and approvedFallback." .
ontosage:Database a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Database"@en ;
rdfs:comment "A registered time-series backend holding sensor readings; the object of ref:storedAt, resolved to a connection through database_registry.yaml."@en ;
skos:example "\"bldg:database2\" — the MySQL instance behind this building's narrow tables" .
ontosage:DisclosureRule a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Data disclosure rule"@en ;
ontosage:layTerms "aggregated, caveated",
"caveated or confirmed",
"confirmed by an owner",
"data sharing rule",
"data sharing rules",
"disclosure rule",
"disclosure rules",
"fields must be suppressed",
"fields to suppress",
"must be suppressed",
"suppressed, aggregated",
"suppression rule",
"suppression rules" ;
rdfs:comment "A rule saying which fields of a view of the building may be shown as they stand, which must be suppressed or aggregated before sharing, which need a caveat and which must be confirmed by their owner first. Declared so that a question about those rules is recognised as one about a register the building may not hold, and is answered by naming what is and is not recorded — instead of by describing a different view of the building that happens to share the words 'space' and 'fields'."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf ontosage:Record ;
skos:example "which fields must be suppressed before this view is shared? -> DisclosureRule where appliesTo matches; none held means the rules are not recorded." .

ontosage:PV_Generation_Power_Sensor a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "PV generation power sensor"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Measures the electrical power a photovoltaic array or inverter is generating, normally in kW. Declared by OntoSage because the pinned Brick version has PV equipment (PV_Panel, PV_Array, Photovoltaic_Inverter) but no generation-power point class, so a question about solar output could only resolve to every power sensor in the building -- and was answered with the floor energy meters."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf brick:Active_Power_Sensor ;
skos:example "\"how much power are the solar panels generating right now?\"" .
ontosage:ParkingArea a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Parking area"@en ;
ontosage:layTerms "car park",
"car parking",
"car parks",
"free parking",
"park my car",
"parking bay",
"parking bays",
"parking space",
"parking spaces",
"staff parking",
"visitor parking",
"where can i park" ;
rdfs:comment "A car park or parking level. Separate from ontosage:BikeStorage (cycles) and from the accessible bays an AccessibilityFeature declares. Holding it as an Amenity lets 'where can I park' be located; how many bays are FREE is a measurement, and belongs to whatever point the building records it at, never to this record."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf ontosage:Amenity ;
skos:example "\"where can I park?\" -> the parking area; \"how many bays are free?\" -> the parking occupancy point." .
ontosage:Parking_Occupancy_Sensor a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Parking bay occupancy / availability sensor"@en ;
rdfs:comment "A count of parking bays that are free or occupied. Brick has no class for this: brick:Occupancy_Count_Sensor is the nearest, and it also covers entrance footfall counters and room people-counters. On the building this was developed against that one class held 257 sensors of which exactly ONE was parking, so a parking question resolved to a class it shared with 256 other things and no answer could be given — the system knew the bay count and could not reach it. Declaring the specific class is the TTL-first fix: the CLASS becomes the discriminator, so nothing downstream needs a label filter, and subclassing the Brick parent means every existing query that asks for Occupancy_Count_Sensor still finds it."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf brick:Occupancy_Count_Sensor ;
skos:example "\"how many parking spaces are free?\"" .
ontosage:Policy a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Policy"@en ;
rdfs:comment "A governing rule of the building — network access, fire safety, data protection, room booking — normally set out in full in an uploaded document. The triple carries the SHORT authoritative answer and, via ontosage:documentRef, names the document that holds the long form. That link is what makes document retrieval deterministic: the question is matched to the policy by lay term, then answered from the document the policy NAMES, instead of whichever chunk a similarity search happened to score highest."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf ontosage:KnowledgeTopic ;
skos:example "\"how do I connect to the wifi?\" -> the network access policy, whose documentRef points at the full policy document." .

ontosage:cat_INFORMATION ;
ontosage:defaultPersonaDepth 0 ;
rdfs:comment "A guest with no prior knowledge of the building. Asks wayfinding, amenity, and access questions."@en .
ontosage:SafetyReport a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Safety report"@en ;
rdfs:comment "A health/safety concern or hazard (blocked exit, spill, trip hazard) — usually high priority."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf ontosage:Report ;
skos:example "\"the fire exit on floor 1 is blocked\"." .
ontosage:Service a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Building service"@en ;
rdfs:comment "A staffed service point (reception, help desk, security desk)."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf ontosage:Amenity ;
skos:example "\"where is reception?\"" .
ontosage:ShowerFacility a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Shower facility"@en ;
ontosage:layTerms "changing facilities",
"changing room",
"changing rooms",
"shower",
"shower facilities",
"shower room",
"shower rooms",
"showers" ;
rdfs:comment "Shower / changing facilities (e.g. for cyclists)."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf ontosage:Amenity ;
skos:example "\"are there showers?\"" .
ontosage:Soil_Moisture_Sensor a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Soil moisture sensor"@en ;
ontosage:measuresQuantityKind ontosage:SoilMoisture ;
rdfs:comment "Measures volumetric water content of a growing medium, reported as a percentage. Declared by OntoSage because the pinned Brick version defines no soil or substrate moisture class; distinct from Relative_Humidity_Sensor, which measures air."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf brick:Sensor ;
skos:example "\"does the green roof need watering?\"" .
ontosage:Src_Document a ontosage:SourceType ;
rdfs:label "Uploaded document"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Prose retrieved from an uploaded manual or policy document. When the topic names its document via ontosage:documentRef the retrieval is scoped to that document; otherwise it was chosen by similarity alone and is weaker evidence."@en .
ontosage:Src_Ontology a ontosage:SourceType ;
rdfs:label "Building ontology (triples)"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Amenity / knowledge-topic / policy facts asserted as triples in the building's own TTL (Module A). Authored and auditable — the answer is what the building states."@en .
ontosage:StudyArea a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Study / workspace area"@en ;
ontosage:layTerms "learning commons",
"learning space",
"learning spaces",
"study pod",
"study pods",
"study room",
"study rooms" ;
rdfs:comment "Open study areas, collaboration pods, quiet workspaces."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf ontosage:Amenity ;
skos:example "\"where can I study?\"" .
ontosage:Suggestion a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Suggestion"@en ;
rdfs:comment "A proposed improvement (add a water fountain, extend café hours)."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf ontosage:Report ;
skos:example "\"you should add more bike racks\"." .
ontosage:VendingMachine a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Vending machine"@en ;
ontosage:layTerms "drink machine",
"drinks machine",
"drinks machines",
"snack machine",
"snack machines",
"vending",
"vending machine",
"vending machines" ;
rdfs:comment "Vending for snacks or drinks. Asked for constantly by occupants and visitors, and answerable only if the building says so — nothing in the sensor model implies it."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf ontosage:Amenity ;
skos:example "\"is there a vending machine in here?\"" .
ontosage:Warranty a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Warranty"@en ;
ontosage:layTerms "defects liability",
"guarantee",
"guarantees",
"in warranty",
"under warranty",
"warranties",
"warranty" ;
rdfs:comment "A manufacturer or installer guarantee attached to a specific asset for a period. Changes the correct answer to a maintenance question — whether the work is chargeable — which no routing fix can recover if the warranty is not modelled."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf ontosage:IntervalRecord ;
skos:example "is the AHU still under warranty? -> Warranty where coversAsset is the AHU and now falls within the interval." .
ontosage:WasteCollectionPoint a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Waste collection point"@en ;
ontosage:layTerms "bin",
"bin collection",
"bin collections",
"bins",
"collection frequency",
"collection point",
"collection round",
"collection rounds",
"emptied",
"fill level",
"food waste",
"full bin",
"general waste",
"missed collection",
"missed collections",
"recycling",
"recycling stream",
"recycling streams",
"refuse",
"skip",
"waste",
"waste collection",
"waste collections",
"waste station",
"waste stream",
"waste streams" ;
rdfs:comment "One bin or container: its station, what the SYSTEM records it as, what the bin is LABELLED, what its aperture physically accepts, its fill against an approved threshold, and when it is next collected. The three stream columns are separate deliberately -- a point recorded as general waste, labelled mixed recycling and fitted with a narrow slot is one people will use wrongly, and collapsing them into a single stream field makes that disagreement unrepresentable when the disagreement IS the answer. Fill threshold is per point, because a 240-litre bin in a busy atrium and a 60-litre one in a quiet corridor do not cross 'full' at the same percentage."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf ontosage:Record ;
skos:example "which points will cross their threshold before the next collection? -> WasteCollectionPoint where fillPercent >= approvedFillThreshold, read with nextDue." .
ontosage:Waste_Fill_Sensor a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Waste fill-level sensor"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Reports how full a waste or recycling receptacle is, as a percentage of its capacity."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf brick:Sensor .
ontosage:Waste_Weight_Sensor a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Waste weight sensor"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Reports the mass of waste in a receptacle or collected from a stream."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf brick:Sensor .
ontosage:aboutEquipment a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "about equipment"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Links a maintenance issue, capability, interval record or standing record to the Brick equipment it concerns, so a fault report or an alarm can be tied to the real asset."@en ;
rdfs:domain [ a owl:Class ;
owl:unionOf ( ontosage:Capability ontosage:IntervalRecord ontosage:Record ) ] ;
rdfs:range brick:Equipment ;
skos:example "bldg:Issue_BrokenLift ontosage:aboutEquipment bldg:Lift_1 ." .
ontosage:aboutPoint a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "about point"@en ;
rdfs:comment "AnomalyEvent: the sensor concerned."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:IntervalRecord ;
rdfs:range brick:Point .
ontosage:aboutSpace a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "about space"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The room/zone the record concerns."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:IntervalRecord ;
rdfs:range brick:Location .
ontosage:accessClassification a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "access tier"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Which of the six access tiers may see this point: public | occupant | operational | safety_security | research | strategic. The conversational layer must enforce the same permissions as the underlying systems and must never become a route around them."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"operational\"" .
ontosage:accessEventKind a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "access event kind"@en ;
rdfs:comment "What happened at the opening: access_denied | held_open | forced_door. An exception log, not a movement log — routine granted entries are not recorded as events."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AccessEvent ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:accessTier a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "access tier"@en ;
rdfs:comment "How far this group's access reaches: public, visitor, occupant, staff, operational or restricted. Advisory context for an answer — the PDP, not this field, decides what is released."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:StakeholderGroup ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:accessibilityKind a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "accessibility feature kind"@en ;
rdfs:comment "hearing_loop | tactile_paving | changing_places | accessible_wc | power_assisted_door | accessible_parking | step_free_entrance | adjustable_desk."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AccessibilityFeature ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:accessibilityNote a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "accessibility note"@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:accessibilityVerified a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "accessibility verified"@en ;
rdfs:comment "True only when the feature has been inspected and confirmed working. ABSENT OR FALSE MEANS UNVERIFIED, and an unverified feature may NOT be presented as accessible — the hard filter fails closed for the same reason a served zone does, but the consequence of getting it wrong is a person stranded rather than a wrong number."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AccessibilityFeature ;
rdfs:range xsd:boolean .
ontosage:accessibilityVerifiedOn a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "accessibility verified on"@en ;
rdfs:comment "When the feature was last inspected. A hearing loop verified three years ago is a claim about a building that may no longer be true."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AccessibilityFeature ;
rdfs:range xsd:date .
ontosage:accountableFor a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "accountable for"@en ;
rdfs:comment "What this group is answerable for, if anything. Blank for groups the building serves rather than groups that run it."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:StakeholderGroup ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:accountableRole a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "accountable role"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Who answers for the subject now. A role, so 'who is accountable' is answerable without exposing who holds what."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:accruedAmount a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "accrued amount"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:CostLine ;
rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
ontosage:acknowledgedAt a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "acknowledged at"@en ;
rdfs:comment "When an operator acknowledged the alarm. ABSENT means it has never been acknowledged — not that the time is unknown — and an unacknowledged active alarm is the case an answer must surface first. Raised is effectiveFrom, cleared is effectiveTo."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AlarmEvent ;
rdfs:range xsd:dateTime .
ontosage:actionsOutstanding a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "actions outstanding"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:IncidentRecord ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:activationCriterion a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "activation criterion"@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:actualAmount a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "actual amount"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:CostLine ;
rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
ontosage:alarmCondition a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "alarm condition"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The condition the alarm reports, in the source system's own words (frost protection trip, high temperature, filter dirty). Read as recorded; never normalised into a severity, which the record carries separately."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AlarmEvent ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:alarmPriority a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "alarm priority"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The priority the source system assigned to this activation. Declared separately from ontosage:priority, whose domain is ontosage:MaintenanceIssue: using that one on an alarm lets an RDFS reasoner type the alarm as a maintenance issue, and so as a KnowledgeTopic."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AlarmEvent ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:allowMinutes a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "allow minutes"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Time to ALLOW, including doors, lifts, waiting and check-in — not walking time, because 'how long should I allow' is the question actually asked."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AccessibleRoute ;
rdfs:range xsd:integer .
ontosage:alternativeCapacity a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "alternative capacity"@en ;
rdfs:comment "What the alternative can actually carry, against what the service needs. A half-capacity fallback is a different answer from a full one."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ContinuityProvision ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:alternativeLocation a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "alternative location"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Where the service runs instead, or 'none identified' where nothing has been arranged. Recorded either way: a missing alternative is the answer somebody needs."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ContinuityProvision ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:alternativePath a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "alternative path"@en ;
rdfs:comment "How the service reaches the alternative: a diverse fibre route, a second riser, a generator feed, a manual process."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ContinuityProvision ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:amenityStatus a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "amenity service status"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Links an amenity to its current ontosage:AssetStatus record. An amenity whose status is out_of_service must be EXCLUDED from recommendations rather than listed with a caveat: somebody who walks to a broken fountain has been given a wrong answer, however well hedged."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Amenity ;
rdfs:range ontosage:AssetStatus .
ontosage:answerText a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "canonical answer"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The one-line canonical answer for a KnowledgeTopic — what OntoSage says when a stakeholder asks about it."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:KnowledgeTopic ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"Complaints go to the Building Manager via the Facilities helpdesk.\"" .
ontosage:answeredBy a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "answered by source type"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The provenance/source type (Module F) an intent is typically answered from — e.g. a Quantify intent is answered by a SPARQL COUNT over the graph, a Trend intent by the time-series DB plus analytics."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:QuestionIntent ;
rdfs:range ontosage:SourceType ;
skos:example "ontosage:Intent_Trend ontosage:answeredBy ontosage:Src_TimeSeriesDB , ontosage:Src_Analytics ." .
ontosage:apertureKind a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "aperture kind"@en ;
rdfs:comment "What the opening physically accepts. A narrow slot will not take flattened card whatever the label claims."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:appliesTo a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "applies to"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The floor, room or zone a closure period or service schedule covers. No domain is declared: it is used by several record kinds, and a domain would type each of them as one class."@en ;
rdfs:range brick:Location .
ontosage:appliesToArea a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "applies to area"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The restricted area or space a competency is required for."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:CompetencyRecord ;
rdfs:range brick:Location .
ontosage:appliesToOutlet a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "applies to outlet"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The amenity, space or floor this statement covers. Scoped rather than building-wide because potability commonly differs between a mains-fed drinking point and a tank-fed tap in the same building."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:PotabilityStatement .
ontosage:appliesToRole a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "applies to role"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Canonical RBAC role name. Personas NEVER map to policies."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AccessPolicy ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:approvalConditions a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "approval conditions"@en ;
rdfs:comment "What a conditional approval depends on, in the register's own words. A condition nobody can read is not a condition."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:approvalDecision a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "approval decision"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Approved, conditional, refused, withdrawn or pending. Refused is RECORDED rather than omitted, so a refused option is never offered by silence."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ApprovalRecord ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:approvalReference a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "approval reference"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The decision's own identifier, so an answer can be traced back to the record that made it."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:approvalRoute a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "approval route"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Who must approve a grant, so 'does this need a formal exception' is answerable from the register rather than from memory."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:approvalSubjectKind a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "approval subject kind"@en ;
rdfs:comment "What sort of thing is approved -- a route, a space use, a procedure, a permission group, a policy, a system, an asset, a cost line."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ApprovalRecord ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:approvedByRole a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "approved by role"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The role that took the decision. Never a person."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ApprovalRecord ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:approvedException a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "approved exception"@en ;
rdfs:comment "A deviation that has been authorised, with its reason. Without this field every legitimate exception reads as a fault, which is how an alarm list becomes noise."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:OperatingRegime ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:approvedFallback a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "approved fallback"@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:approvedFillThreshold a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "approved fill threshold"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Per point, not a constant: a service decision about when this container needs emptying."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:integer .
ontosage:approvedOn a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "approved on"@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:date .
ontosage:archivalIntervalS a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "archival interval (s)"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The permanent canonical resolution. Third of the three clocks, and the one a completeness gate needs: expected sample count over a window is derived from THIS, never assumed."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:integer ;
skos:example "\"60\"^^xsd:integer" .
ontosage:asksAbout a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "typically asks about"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Associates a stakeholder role with a capability category it most commonly asks about, so answers and suggestions can be prioritised for the audience. Advisory only — any role may ask anything."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:StakeholderRole ;
rdfs:range skos:Concept ;
skos:example "ontosage:Role_SustainabilityOfficer ontosage:asksAbout ontosage:cat_SUSTAINABILITY ." .
ontosage:assistanceContact a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "assistance contact"@en ;
rdfs:comment "A non-telephone arrival contact."@en,
"Who to contact when this asset is unavailable. Present so a decline can be USEFUL: 'the lift is out of service, and step-free access to level 5 is via the estates helpdesk on x1234' is an answer; 'the lift is out of service' strands someone."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:avComponentKind a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "AV component kind"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AVReadiness ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:backtestMAE a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "backtest MAE"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ForecastSkill ;
rdfs:range xsd:double .
ontosage:backtestMAPE a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "backtest MAPE (%)"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ForecastSkill ;
rdfs:range xsd:double .
ontosage:bandSource a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "band source"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Where the bound comes from. A number with no provenance becomes a fact by being copied."@en .
ontosage:baselineValue a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "baseline value"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The expected-band context the deviation is measured against."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AnomalyEvent ;
rdfs:range xsd:double .
ontosage:bookedByRole a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "booked by role"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The organising ROLE or team. Never a named individual: an availability question does not need one."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Booking ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:budgetAmount a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "budget amount"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:CostLine ;
rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
ontosage:buildingAccessPolicy a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "access policy"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Whether and how outsiders may enter — the honest answer to 'are visitors allowed?' and 'is check-in staffed or automated?', which otherwise get guessed."@en ;
rdfs:domain brick:Building ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"Visitors welcome during staffed reception hours; sign in at the ground-floor desk.\"" .
ontosage:buildingAddress a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "address"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Street address as a person would write it. Brick carries coordinates for geometry; this carries the form a human asks for and can act on."@en ;
rdfs:domain brick:Building ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"Example Building, 1 Campus Road, Exampletown EX1 2AB\"" .
ontosage:buildingArchitect a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "architect or builder"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Who designed or constructed the building. Asked more often than expected — by visitors, students and anyone curious about the building itself rather than its systems."@en ;
rdfs:domain brick:Building ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"Hoare Lea (services), Willmott Dixon (construction)\"" .
ontosage:buildingOccupancyType a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "occupancy type"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Who uses the building — staff, students, public, residents, tenants. Answers 'is this a residence?', 'is this commercial?', 'can the public come in?' without inferring it from the sensor mix."@en ;
rdfs:domain brick:Building ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"Staff and students; public access to the ground floor during opening hours\"" .
ontosage:buildingOperator a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "operator"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The organisation or team responsible for running the building day to day — usually who an occupant actually needs when something is wrong."@en ;
rdfs:domain brick:Building ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"Estates & Campus Services\"" .
ontosage:buildingOwner a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "owner"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The organisation that owns the building. Distinct from the operator: an owner may lease the building to whoever runs it day to day, and 'who owns this?' and 'who runs this?' are different questions with different answers."@en ;
rdfs:domain brick:Building ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"Example University\"" .
ontosage:buildingPurpose a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "purpose"@en ;
rdfs:comment "One or two sentences on what the building is FOR, in plain language. brick:buildingPrimaryFunction gives a controlled classification ('Education'); this gives the sentence a person actually wanted."@en ;
rdfs:domain brick:Building ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"Teaching and research building for computer science and mathematics, with lecture theatres, labs and academic offices.\"" .
ontosage:buildingStoreys a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "number of storeys"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Declared storey count. Usually the live count of brick:Floor instances is the better answer and is preferred; this exists for buildings whose declared storeys differ from the floors modelled in the graph (a basement or plant deck that carries no sensors)."@en ;
rdfs:domain brick:Building ;
rdfs:range xsd:integer ;
skos:example "\"5\"^^xsd:integer" .
ontosage:busiestPeriod a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "busiest period"@en ;
rdfs:comment "When this space is typically hardest to get a seat in. A TYPICAL PATTERN, not a live occupancy reading — 'when should I arrive?' is a question about the pattern, and answering it from the current count would be wrong tomorrow."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:WorkspaceProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:calibratedOn a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "calibration date"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Date this point was last calibrated. Absence means UNKNOWN — not uncalibrated, and not fine: a standards or compliance verdict may not rest on a point whose calibration state is unknown."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:date ;
skos:example "\"2026-03-14\"^^xsd:date" .
ontosage:calibrationDueOn a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "calibration due date"@en ;
rdfs:comment "When calibration next falls due. Lets a gate distinguish EXPIRED from never-calibrated — a different remedy, and a different level of trust in the interim readings."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:date .
ontosage:calibrationMethod a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "calibration method"@en ;
rdfs:comment "How the calibration was performed, and against what reference. Master 10.1 asks for comparison against trusted reference instruments; recording the method is what makes one calibration comparable to another."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"NDIR two-point against a certified 400/1000 ppm reference\"" .
ontosage:capabilityCategory a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "capability category"@en ;
rdfs:comment "A coarse category tag for grouping/filtering. Suggested values: AMENITIES, ACCESSIBILITY, INFORMATION, PROCEDURE, MAINTENANCE, SAFETY, SUSTAINABILITY."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Capability ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"MAINTENANCE\"" .
ontosage:capacityBasis a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "capacity basis"@en ;
rdfs:comment "How the space's hbco:roomCapacity was arrived at: certified, surveyed, or ESTIMATED from floor-plan area at a stated density, with the density and its source. A capacity with no basis cannot be told apart from a certified fire capacity, and an estimate quoted as a limit is a safety claim nobody made."@en ;
rdfs:domain brick:Space ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:capacityLitres a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "capacity in litres"@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:integer .
ontosage:capacitySource a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "capacity source"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Which source a retained hbco:roomCapacity record came from: \"ttl\" (the building's own model) or \"drawing\" (the architect's drawing, a second source). The reader takes the TTL figure for a space whenever the TTL holds one, and reads a drawing only when it holds none. Carried by the record, not the space, so a superseded TTL figure and a drawing figure stay distinguishable."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:checkInFrom a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "check-in from"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:PublicEvent ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:ciCoverage80 a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "80% CI coverage (measured)"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Fraction of holdout actuals inside the 80% interval — calibration, not hope."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ForecastSkill ;
rdfs:range xsd:double .
ontosage:circuitSequence a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "circuit sequence"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Position within the circuit, so a route can be reported in the order it is walked."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:PatrolCheckpoint ;
rdfs:range xsd:integer .
ontosage:cleaningStandard a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "cleaning standard"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The specification applied on a visit — enhanced, standard, presentation or light. Distinct from frequency: a room may be cleaned daily to a light standard."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:CleaningTask ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:cleaningZone a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "cleaning zone"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The named division of the building a shift is responsible for."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:CleaningTask ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:closureReason a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "closure reason"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Why the space is closed, in terms a person can act on."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ClosurePeriod ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:codingCheckRequired a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "coding check required"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Flagged on the row rather than kept as a list, because a list goes stale the moment the row is corrected."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:CostLine ;
rdfs:range xsd:boolean .
ontosage:commandedBySystem a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "commanded by system"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Which system commands the opening: fire alarm, access control, building management or none."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:DoorHardware ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:commissionedDuty a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "commissioned duty"@en ;
rdfs:comment "What commissioning actually witnessed and signed off. Separate from design duty because the two routinely differ, and the difference is the answer."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AssetEngineeringProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:committedAmount a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "committed amount"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Money a purchase order has claimed but not yet spent. Separate from actual so a free balance cannot be overstated."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:CostLine ;
rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
ontosage:companionPolicy a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "companion policy"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Whether a companion or support person may attend, and whether they register separately."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:PublicEvent ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:competencyQuestion a owl:AnnotationProperty ;
rdfs:label "competency question"@en ;
rdfs:comment "A natural-language question the annotated term is designed to help answer. Used to document and evaluate schema coverage, and as a retrieval anchor for LLM query generation."@en .
ontosage:completedDate a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "completed date"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:IntervalRecord ;
rdfs:range xsd:dateTime .
ontosage:concernsIssue a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "concerns issue"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Links a report to the Module A ontosage:MaintenanceIssue it is an instance of, so its report route / priority are inherited."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Report ;
rdfs:range ontosage:MaintenanceIssue ;
skos:example "bldg:Report_042 ontosage:concernsIssue bldg:Issue_WaterLeak ." .
ontosage:conditionGrade a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "condition grade"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The grade recorded by the surveyor (A good, B satisfactory, C poor, D end of life), kept verbatim and never re-derived."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ConditionSurvey ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:configLocation a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "configuration location"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Where the point was during this configuration period. The name building data and the evidence history query use; a sub-property of ontosage:periodLocation."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ConfigurationPeriod ;
rdfs:range brick:Location ;
rdfs:subPropertyOf ontosage:periodLocation .
ontosage:configurationChange a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "configuration change"@en ;
rdfs:comment "What changed at the start of this period: relocation | recalibration | replacement | firmware | commissioning. Reported alongside any trend that spans the boundary, so a measurement artefact is never presented as building behaviour."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ConfigurationPeriod ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"recalibration\"" .
ontosage:configurationOf a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "configuration of"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The point a configuration period describes. The direction building data uses (period to point); ontosage:hasConfigurationPeriod states the same link from the point."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ConfigurationPeriod ;
rdfs:range brick:Point .
ontosage:contactEmail a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "contact email"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The email to contact about this topic."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:KnowledgeTopic ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"estates@example.ac.uk\"" .
ontosage:contactPhone a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "contact phone"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The phone number to contact about this topic."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:KnowledgeTopic ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"029 2087 6026\"" .
ontosage:controlMeasure a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "control measure"@en ;
rdfs:comment "What actually keeps the hazard safe. The thing that must not silently stop working."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:HazardControl ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:controlsOpening a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "controls opening"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The controlled door, gate or turnstile this grant applies to."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AccessPermission ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:costCentre a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "cost centre"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:CostLine ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:coveredScope a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "covered scope"@en ;
rdfs:comment "What a contract or warranty covers, in the words of its owner."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:IntervalRecord ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:coversAsset a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "covers asset"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The equipment a warranty, contract, handover record or condition survey concerns."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:IntervalRecord ;
rdfs:range brick:Equipment .
ontosage:criterionState a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "criterion state"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Met, not met, conflicting or UNKNOWN. Unknown is not a blank: it is the statement that nobody has established this, which is a different decision from 'not met'."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:criticality a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "criticality"@en ;
rdfs:comment "continuity-critical, high, medium or low — what failure would actually stop."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AssetEngineeringProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:cubicleCount a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "cubicle count"@en ;
rdfs:comment "How many cubicles the washroom block holds. A block of five cubicles is one facility with five, not five facilities -- counting it either way without saying which is how a floor's provision gets misreported."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:integer .
ontosage:currencyCode a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "currency"@en ;
rdfs:comment "ISO currency code. Stated in every cost answer — a bare number is ambiguous across buildings."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Tariff ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:currencyThresholdDays a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "currency threshold (days)"@en ;
rdfs:comment "How long a record of this class stays current, set by its owner. Staleness is decision-specific: a CO2 reading is stale in minutes, an asbestos survey in years. One global freshness rule must either call a valid survey stale or let an hours-old reading pass as current."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:integer .
ontosage:dataNeeds a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "data needs"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The kinds of building data this group asks for, in their own words."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:StakeholderGroup ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:daylightAspect a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "daylight aspect"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Orientation and daylight character, including glare risk at particular times."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:WorkspaceProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:decisionRequired a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "decision required"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Whether an authorised decision is owed before the next operational period. A column rather than prose, because it is the single thing a coordinator most needs listed."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:boolean .
ontosage:defaultPersonaDepth a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "default persona depth"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Default technical depth (0=lay .. 4=expert) for answers to this role; mirrors hbco:personaDepth so environment explanations match the audience."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:StakeholderRole ;
rdfs:range xsd:integer ;
skos:example "ontosage:Role_Occupant ontosage:defaultPersonaDepth 0 ." .
ontosage:denialReason a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "denial reason"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Why access was refused, as the controller recorded it (outside the role's time profile, zone not in the permission group). Blank on events that were not refusals."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AccessEvent ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:departmentFunction a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "department function"@en ;
rdfs:comment "What this department exists to do, in one line."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Department ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:dependsOnLift a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "depends on lift"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Whether the step-free time assumes the lift. When it fails, every journey marked true has no step-free alternative at all rather than a slower one."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:CirculationTime ;
rdfs:range xsd:boolean .
ontosage:dependsOnSpace a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "depends on space"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The space or system the service normally runs from. The thing whose loss the rest of the row answers."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ContinuityProvision ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:derivedFromDocument a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "derived from document"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Set on every fact LIFTED from a record document. A document is a statement ABOUT a system of record, not the record itself, so these rank below authored TTL in precedence — without the marker a stale Markdown table could silently outrank a live register."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:IntervalRecord ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:designDuty a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "design duty"@en ;
rdfs:comment "What the asset was specified to do, with its unit. The claim on the drawing."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AssetEngineeringProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:detectedBy a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "detected by"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Detector id, e.g. seasonal_residual, stuck_sensor."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AnomalyEvent ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:divertedPercent a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "diverted percent"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The share of this stream's tonnage the contractor reports as not sent to landfill. The building's share is the tonnage-weighted figure, not the mean of these."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:WasteReturn ;
rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
ontosage:documentRef a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "backing document"@en ;
rdfs:comment "File name of the uploaded document that sets out this topic in full, relative to the building's own documents/ folder. This is the ONE assertion that makes document retrieval deterministic. Without it a question is matched to a document by cosine similarity alone, against a floor calibrated on one corpus and one embedding model — so changing either silently changes which document answers which question. With it, the question is matched to the TOPIC by lay term and the answer is drawn from the document the topic NAMES; similarity then only orders chunks WITHIN the right document. No building name appears in code: the building declares its own documents."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:KnowledgeTopic ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"fire_safety.md\"" .
ontosage:doorOperation a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "door operation"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Automatic, assisted or manual, PER ROUTE — a step-free route can still carry a heavy manual door, which is the difference between usable and not."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AccessibleRoute ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:doorsOpenAt a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "doors open at"@en ;
rdfs:comment "When a visitor may enter, which is earlier than the start and is the time they actually need."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:PublicEvent ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:downstreamDependencies a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "downstream dependencies"@en ;
rdfs:comment "What stops working when this is isolated. The field that turns a five-minute isolation into a decision."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AssetEngineeringProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:dueDate a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "due date"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ComplianceCheck ;
rdfs:range xsd:dateTime .
ontosage:dutyEvidence a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "duty evidence"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The document or record that substantiates the commissioned duty. Without it the duty is an assertion."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AssetEngineeringProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:effectiveDate a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "effective date"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Date this policy came into force. Lets an answer say WHICH version it is quoting, and lets a superseded policy be spotted rather than silently answered from."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:KnowledgeTopic ;
rdfs:range xsd:date ;
skos:example "\"2026-01-01\"^^xsd:date" .
ontosage:effectiveFrom a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "effective from"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Start of the period. Inclusive."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ConfigurationPeriod ;
rdfs:range xsd:dateTime .
ontosage:effectiveTo a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "effective until"@en ;
rdfs:comment "End of the period. ABSENT means still in force — the open interval is the normal case, and writing a far-future date instead would silently expire."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ConfigurationPeriod ;
rdfs:range xsd:dateTime .
ontosage:endsAt a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "ends at"@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:engineeringSystem a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "engineering system"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The system this asset belongs to: chilled water, ventilation, LV distribution, fire, transport, metering. The grouping an estates or M&E question uses before it names any individual item."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AssetEngineeringProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:environmentalBoundary a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "environmental boundary"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The space whose conditions this point actually measures. Usually the space that contains it — but NOT always, which is the entire reason the property exists: a sensor in a duct, a plenum, or mounted on a corridor wall serving an adjacent room has a containing space that is not the space it describes. The non-substitution rule (Master 8) is enforced against THIS, never against containment."@en ;
rdfs:range brick:Location .
ontosage:escalatesTo a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "escalates to"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The function a request escalates to when the response target is missed or the issue exceeds this department's scope."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Department ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:evidenceDate a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "evidence date"@en ;
rdfs:comment "When the evidence was produced -- distinct from when the approval was made, because evidence ages and approvals do not."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:date .
ontosage:evidenceKind a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "evidence kind"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Certificate, survey, test record, inspection, sign-off, committee minute or drawing. ABSENT means no evidence is recorded, which is a finding rather than a blank."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ApprovalRecord ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:evidenceReference a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "evidence reference"@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:exampleSparql a owl:AnnotationProperty ;
rdfs:label "example SPARQL"@en ;
rdfs:comment "A worked SPARQL query answering a competency question for the annotated term, over a combined Brick + OCBV graph (prefixes bldg:, brick:, ontosage:, hbco:)."@en .
ontosage:expectedAttendance a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "expected attendance"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Planned headcount. An institutional expectation, never an occupancy measurement — a planned figure must not be reported as an observed one."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:integer .
ontosage:expectedAttendees a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "expected attendees"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The group size the booking was made for, used for capacity and turnaround checks."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Booking ;
rdfs:range xsd:integer .
ontosage:expectedMinutes a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "expected minutes"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Planned duration, so a shift's workload can be summed against the hours available."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:integer .
ontosage:externallyReportable a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "externally reportable"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Whether this must be reported to a regulator. A legal obligation, not a severity judgement."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:IncidentRecord ;
rdfs:range xsd:boolean .
ontosage:failStateOnPowerLoss a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "fail state on power loss"@en ;
rdfs:comment "How the opening rests when power is lost: fail open (releases), fail locked (stays secure), fail safe (releases for escape) or fail closed (drops, as a fire shutter does). Recorded, never inferred from the opening kind."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:DoorHardware ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:faultState a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "fault state"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Current fault condition, where the device or BMS reports one."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:fillPercent a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "fill percent"@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:integer .
ontosage:financialPeriod a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "financial period"@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:fireAssetKind a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "fire asset kind"@en ;
rdfs:comment "detection, alarm, suppression, extinguisher, fire door, compartmentation, escape provision or signage."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:FireSafetyAsset ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:fromFloor a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "from floor"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:CirculationTime ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:genderProvision a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "gender provision"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Who the facility is for: male, female, gender-neutral or unisex. Kept separate from accessibility because a reader may need either, and often needs both."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:grantedToRole a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "granted to role"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The role template a grant is made to. Never a person."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AccessPermission ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:groundedIn a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "grounded in"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Records a source type that produced (part of) an answer. An answer with no ontosage:groundedIn is not grounded and must not assert figures — the honest 'no data' path applies instead."@en ;
rdfs:range ontosage:SourceType ;
skos:example "an answer about last week's CO₂ trend ontosage:groundedIn ontosage:Src_TimeSeriesDB , ontosage:Src_Analytics ." .
ontosage:groupFriendly a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "group friendly"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Whether two or more people may work together here without breaching the space's own noise expectation."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:WorkspaceProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:boolean .
ontosage:hasConfigurationPeriod a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "has configuration period"@en ;
rdfs:domain brick:Point ;
rdfs:range ontosage:ConfigurationPeriod .
ontosage:hazardCondition a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "hazard condition"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Current assessed condition of the hazard itself, distinct from the state of its control — an asbestos material in good condition under a damaged label is a different problem from a damaged material."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:HazardControl ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:hazardKind a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "hazard kind"@en ;
rdfs:comment "COSHH substance, local exhaust ventilation, asbestos-containing material, water system or biological."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:HazardControl ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:holdOpenDevice a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "hold-open device"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The device holding the opening open in normal use, and what drops it — an acoustic or wired hold-open, a magnet on the fire panel, or none."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:DoorHardware ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:horizonHours a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "horizon (hours)"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ForecastSkill ;
rdfs:range xsd:double .
ontosage:immediateAction a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "immediate action"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:IncidentRecord ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:inAudioPath a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "in audio path"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Whether the component is a link in the amplified audio chain. A format needing a microphone fails if any link is down, whatever the display is doing."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AVReadiness ;
rdfs:range xsd:boolean .
ontosage:incidentCategory a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "incident category"@en ;
rdfs:comment "injury, near miss, property damage, security, environmental or service failure."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:IncidentRecord ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:incidentSeverity a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "incident severity"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Actual severity of what happened. Kept apart from potential severity, because a near miss with low actual and high potential severity is the most important row in any incident register."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:IncidentRecord ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:inferenceClass a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "inference class rule"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Question-shape rules, e.g. individual_presence:deny — the system explains the building, never tracks individuals."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AccessPolicy ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:infoUrl a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "information URL"@en ;
rdfs:comment "A URL where a stakeholder can find more information."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:KnowledgeTopic ;
rdfs:range xsd:anyURI ;
skos:example "\"https://itservicedesk.example.ac.uk\"" .
ontosage:inheritsFrom a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "inherits from"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The parent group whose grant this one extends. Empty means the group stands alone; the chain is data so an inherited path can be reported rather than described."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AccessPermission ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:inspectionIntervalDays a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "inspection interval days"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The intended interval between physical visits. With lastVisited this makes the 'longest blind interval' question a calculation."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AssetEngineeringProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:integer .
ontosage:intentPattern a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "intent phrasings"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Comma-separated example phrasings / trigger cues for an intent — the lay grammar OntoSage matches to classify a question into this intent."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:QuestionIntent ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"how many, count, number of, total\"" .
ontosage:investigationFinding a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "investigation finding"@en ;
rdfs:comment "What the investigation concluded. Blank where none has been done — and a blank on a high-potential row is itself the finding."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:IncidentRecord ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:isBookable a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "is bookable"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Whether the space can be reserved. A space that cannot be booked can still be free, and the two questions differ."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:WorkspaceProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:boolean .
ontosage:isOptional a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "is optional"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Whether the activity can be skipped. Recorded by whoever owns the programme, never judged."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:boolean .
ontosage:isStatutory a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "is statutory"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Whether missing this task is a legal failure rather than an inconvenience: a missed weekly fire alarm test is reportable, a lift without a current examination may not run, a missed carpet clean is neither. Recorded by the owner of the schedule, never judged. It is the OPPOSITE of ontosage:isOptional, which an earlier mapping wrongly used for it."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ServiceSchedule ;
rdfs:range xsd:boolean .
ontosage:isStepFree a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "is step free"@en ;
rdfs:comment "False is recorded, not omitted: a route missing from the register is unknown, while a route marked false is known to be unsuitable, and an answer must be able to tell those apart."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AccessibleRoute ;
rdfs:range xsd:boolean .
ontosage:isTemporary a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "is temporary"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Event assets come and go. Without this the register answers the wrong question after every event."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:boolean .
ontosage:isolationPoint a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "isolation point"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Where this asset is isolated for safe work. The single most load-bearing field for anyone about to touch it."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AssetEngineeringProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:isolationProvenOn a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "isolation proven on"@en ;
rdfs:comment "When the isolation was last PROVED dead rather than assumed. A documented isolation point that nobody has proved is a claim."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AssetEngineeringProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:date .
ontosage:jobHours a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "job hours"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Hours of work booked to the job: the time taken on a completed order, the allowance on an open one. In HOURS -- ontosage:expectedMinutes is minutes and holds a different unit for a different class."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:WorkOrder ;
rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
ontosage:labelledStream a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "labelled waste stream"@en ;
rdfs:comment "What is printed on the bin. Separate from the recorded stream so the two can be compared rather than assumed equal."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:lastCompleted a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "last completed"@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:date .
ontosage:lastCounted a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "last counted"@en ;
rdfs:comment "When somebody counted the shelf. Stock not counted this month is a claim, not a count."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:StockItem ;
rdfs:range xsd:date .
ontosage:lastProvedOn a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "last proved on"@en ;
rdfs:comment "When the arrangement was last exercised end to end. Without a date and an evidence reference the row is unverified, whatever the plan says."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ContinuityProvision ;
rdfs:range xsd:date .
ontosage:lastTestedOn a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "last tested on"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:FireSafetyAsset ;
rdfs:range xsd:date .
ontosage:lastVisited a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "last visited"@en ;
rdfs:comment "When a person last physically attended this asset — not when a sensor last reported it."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AssetEngineeringProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:date .
ontosage:leadTimeDays a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "lead time (days)"@en ;
rdfs:comment "How long a reorder normally takes to arrive. Left blank where nothing has been agreed rather than guessed."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:StockItem ;
rdfs:range xsd:integer .
ontosage:liftStatus a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "lift status"@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:liftedByMapping a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "lifted by mapping"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The record-document mapping that produced this fact, so a wrong value can be traced to the rule that made it rather than only to the document."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:IntervalRecord ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:locatedIn a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "located in"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Ties a capability to the Brick location (floor / room / zone) it sits in, so spatial questions can join OCBV facts to the Brick model. RANGE IS A brick:Location — this is the primary OCBV↔Brick bridge."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Capability ;
rdfs:range brick:Location ;
skos:example "bldg:PrayerRoom_104 ontosage:locatedIn bldg:Room_1.04 ." ;
skos:relatedMatch bot:containsElement,
rec:isLocationOf .
ontosage:locatedInSpace a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "located in space"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The space a record's location text names exactly, resolved when the record was lifted. Joins a register row to the sensors and properties of that space. Written beside ontosage:locationText, never instead of it, and absent wherever the text named no single space."@en ;
rdfs:range brick:Location ;
skos:example "?record ontosage:locatedInSpace ?space . ?sensor brick:hasLocation ?space ." .
ontosage:locationText a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "human-readable location"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Free-text location for an amenity, as a person would describe it."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Amenity ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"Floor 1, room 1.04\" or \"Left of the main entrance, ~25 m\"" .
ontosage:locationVerifiedOn a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "location verified on"@en ;
rdfs:comment "When the recorded location was last confirmed against the asset's actual position. A location nobody has checked is a record, not a fact — and 'does the recorded location match where the asset can currently be found?' is a question about this field, not about the location field."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AssetEngineeringProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:date .
ontosage:measuresQuantityKind a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "measures quantity kind"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The physical quantity a sensor class measures, stated by OntoSage rather than inferred from a class hierarchy. Two classes related by rdfs:subClassOf may still measure different quantities: Brick puts TVOC under Particulate_Matter_Sensor because that class means 'pollutant sensor' in Brick's own definition, not because a VOC is a particulate. Where they differ, a count rolled up the hierarchy has to say what it included."@en .
ontosage:meterServes a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "meter serves"@en ;
rdfs:comment "What a meter's reading covers: the building, a floor or a system. An energy answer states this boundary, so a floor sub-meter is never read as the whole building's consumption."@en ;
skos:example "bldg:Building_Electrical_Meter ontosage:meterServes bldg:Building ." .
ontosage:minAggregationSensors a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "k-anonymity sensor floor"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AccessPolicy ;
rdfs:range xsd:integer .
ontosage:minAggregationSpaces a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "k-anonymity space floor"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AccessPolicy ;
rdfs:range xsd:integer .
ontosage:minimumLevel a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "minimum level"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The quantity below which the line is reordered. For loan equipment, the number needed to keep every timetabled teaching room covered. Always zero for surplus."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:StockItem ;
rdfs:range xsd:integer .
ontosage:mountingHeightM a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "mounting height (m)"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Height above finished floor. HSE guidance places CO2 monitors at head height and away from openings; a sensor at ceiling level measures something different from one at desk level, and an answer that ignores this compares unlike with unlike."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:decimal ;
skos:example "\"1.2\"^^xsd:decimal" .
ontosage:nearestVerticalRoute a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "nearest vertical route"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The lift or stair core serving this space, so travel between levels can be reasoned about rather than guessed."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:WorkspaceProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:networkRating a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "network rating"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Surveyed wireless quality in this space: strong, adequate or weak. Surveyed, not inferred from the nearest access point, because a wall between them is the usual reason an answer is wrong."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:WorkspaceProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:nextDue a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "next due"@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:date .
ontosage:nextTestDue a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "next test due"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:FireSafetyAsset ;
rdfs:range xsd:date .
ontosage:noiseProfile a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "noise profile"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The acoustic expectation people hold for this space: silent, quiet, conversational or busy. An expectation, not a measurement — it is what makes a group in the wrong room a problem."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:WorkspaceProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:note a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "additional detail"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Any extra free-text detail (features, caveats, opening notes)."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Capability ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"Multi-faith, open to all; wudu facilities adjacent.\"" .
ontosage:observedDuty a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "observed duty"@en ;
rdfs:comment "What the asset is currently measured to deliver. Blank where nothing measures it — and a blank here is a finding, not a gap in the register."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AssetEngineeringProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:observedValue a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "observed value"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The reading that deviated, in the unit of the point it is about (ontosage:aboutPoint). Compared against ontosage:baselineValue; neither is meaningful without the other."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AnomalyEvent ;
rdfs:range xsd:double .
ontosage:occupiedSetpoint a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "occupied setpoint"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:OperatingRegime ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:onFloor a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "floor identifier"@en ;
rdfs:comment "A floor label for an amenity (free text; use ontosage:locatedIn/servesFloor to link the actual brick:Floor)."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Amenity ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"1\" or \"Ground\"" .
ontosage:onFloorEntity a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "on floor (entity)"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The floor a record's floor text names, resolved by the floor's declared level number or, failing that, the number in the floor's own name or its exact label. Points only at a brick:Floor. Also written when a location text names a whole floor and nothing else, so a query for the space a record is in never returns a floor."@en ;
rdfs:range brick:Location ;
skos:example "?record ontosage:onFloorEntity ?floor . ?space brick:isPartOf ?floor ." .
ontosage:openDefect a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "open defect"@en ;
rdfs:comment "A defect recorded against this asset and not yet closed. Blank means none recorded, which is not the same as none present, and the register says so."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:FireSafetyAsset ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:openException a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "open exception"@en ;
rdfs:comment "What must be called out at handover, in the register's own words."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:openingHours a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "opening hours"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Free-text opening hours for an amenity or service."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Capability ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"Mon-Fri 09:00-16:30; closed weekends\"" .
ontosage:openingKind a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "opening kind"@en ;
rdfs:comment "What the opening is: escape door, fire shutter, security door, turnstile, vehicle barrier."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:DoorHardware ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:operatingWindow a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "operating window"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The hours the system is approved to run. A reading outside this window is only a fault once this says so."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:OperatingRegime ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:operationalPeriod a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "operational period"@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:outOfHoursRoute a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "out of hours route"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Who answers outside coverage hours. Separate from requestChannel because they routinely differ, and an occupant told the daytime queue at 22:00 is told the wrong thing."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Department ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:overriddenBy a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "overridden by"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Global modes or controller rules that supersede the time profile. Recorded on the row they override, because that is where someone checking the group will look."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AccessPermission ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:owningAuthority a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "owning authority"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The organisation whose system of record this is (Estates, HR, the maintainer). Distinct from recordOwner, which is the accountable role inside it."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:IntervalRecord ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:parentAsset a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "parent asset"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The asset this one is a part of, if any. Blank for a top-level plant item. Asset-management questions are about the CHAIN — is each asset linked to the correct parent, system, served area and dependency — and a register of unconnected items cannot answer one of them."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AssetEngineeringProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:partOfEvent a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "part of event"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The PublicEvent this activity belongs to, by record id, so the two registers join."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:EventActivity ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:patrolCircuit a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "patrol circuit"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:PatrolCheckpoint ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:permitKind a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "permit kind"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Hot works, roof access, confined space, electrical isolation, work at height."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Permit ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:physicalMax a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "physical maximum"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The highest value this quantity can physically take in a building. Set at or above the emergency/IDLH level rather than at a comfort limit: a dangerous reading must still be reportable, and only an impossible one suppressed."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Measurand .
ontosage:physicalMin a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "physical minimum"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The lowest value this quantity can physically take in a building. Below it, the reading is not a measurement of this quantity -- most often the stream is carrying a different quantity's scale. This is a POSSIBILITY bound, deliberately wider than any comfort or compliance band."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Measurand .
ontosage:physicalUnit a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "physical unit"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The unit the band is expressed in. A band without its unit is how a ppm range comes to be applied to a stream in ppb."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Measurand .
ontosage:policyOwner a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "policy owner"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The team accountable for this policy, so an answer can say who to take it up with rather than leaving the user to guess."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:KnowledgeTopic ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"IT Services\"" .
ontosage:positionOnFloor a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "position on floor"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Where on the floor it is, in the words the survey used ('north end', 'by the east stair'), for provision recorded by position rather than by room number. Never invent a room number to fill this: a wrong room is worse than an approximate direction."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:potabilityAuthority a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "issuing authority"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Who published the statement and stands behind it. Required, because a drinkability claim with no owner is exactly the kind of confident unattributable assertion the evidence discipline exists to prevent."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:PotabilityStatement ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:potabilityIssuedOn a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "issued on"@en ;
rdfs:comment "When the statement was published. A potability statement from four years ago describes a plumbing system that may since have been altered."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:PotabilityStatement ;
rdfs:range xsd:date .
ontosage:potabilityValue a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "potability"@en ;
rdfs:comment "potable | not_potable | unknown. UNKNOWN is the default and is a legitimate answer: 'nobody has published a statement about this outlet' is honest, whereas assuming either value is a health claim nobody made."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:PotabilityStatement ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:potentialSeverity a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "potential severity"@en ;
rdfs:comment "What could reasonably have happened. The field that stops a near miss being filed and forgotten."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:IncidentRecord ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:powerAccess a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "power access"@en ;
rdfs:comment "How reliably a laptop can be plugged in: at every seat, at some seats, perimeter only, or none."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:WorkspaceProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:presencePattern a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "presence pattern"@en ;
rdfs:comment "When this group is typically in the building. The field that makes 'who is affected by a Saturday shutdown?' answerable."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:StakeholderGroup ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:presentedRole a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "presented role"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The ROLE TEMPLATE of the credential presented (caretaking and cleaning, academic staff, contractor) — NEVER an individual, a card number or anything that identifies a person. Per-person access questions are refused by inference-class policy whatever this field holds."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AccessEvent ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:previousLocationText a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "previous location"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Where a record used to be. ABSENT means the register records no move — not that nothing changed, and an answer must say which."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:primaryNeed a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "primary need"@en ;
rdfs:comment "What this group mostly comes to the building's data for."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:StakeholderGroup ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:primarySystem a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "primary system"@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
