ontosage:priority a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "default priority"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Suggested default priority for a maintenance issue. Values: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, URGENT."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:MaintenanceIssue ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"URGENT\" (e.g. a water leak or anyone trapped in a lift)" .
ontosage:providerName a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "provider"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The supplier, maintainer or issuing body."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:IntervalRecord ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:provisionKind a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "provision kind"@en ;
rdfs:comment "refuge point, evacuation chair, communication unit, personal plan or assisted route."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:EvacuationProvision ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:provisionState a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "provision state"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:EvacuationProvision ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:qualifierTerms a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "qualifier terms"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The subset of a record class's layTerms that name the class only when used OF it, not when describing something else. 'Is this route approved?' is about approval; 'the approved schedule' is about a schedule. A qualifier followed directly by a content word is read as describing that word and does not count as evidence for the class. Declare a term here when its adjective use is common and names a property of other things."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "ontosage:ApprovalRecord ontosage:qualifierTerms \"approved\", \"verified\" ." .
ontosage:qualityFlag a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "data quality flag"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Operator-asserted quality state of this point: good | suspect | faulty | unknown. Distinct from computed health (which comes from the readings themselves) because an operator may know a sensor is faulty before the data shows it, and may know a plausible-looking series is wrong."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"suspect\"" .
ontosage:quantityOnHand a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "quantity on hand"@en ;
rdfs:comment "What was counted on the shelf on lastCounted. Loan equipment that is out on loan is not on hand."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:StockItem ;
rdfs:range xsd:integer .
ontosage:quietestPeriod a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "quietest period"@en ;
rdfs:comment "When a seat is typically easiest to find here."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:WorkspaceProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:rateLimit a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "rate limit"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Serialized 'maxQueries:perMinutes'; 0 = unlimited."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AccessPolicy ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:rateUnit a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "rate unit"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The unit the unit rate is charged per (kWh, m3). Transcribed from the tariff's own document, never assumed from the utility."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Tariff ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "bldg:tariff/TAR-WATER-2026 ontosage:rateUnit \"m3\" ." .
ontosage:readyBy a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "ready by"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The time an area must be released for use. A service commitment, so a task still open past it is an exception to report rather than a task running late."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:recordId a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "record id"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The identifier this record carries in its own system of record (PTW-2026-0412, a contract number, a survey reference). Quoted back in answers so a reader can find the original, and used as the stable IRI slot so re-ingesting a document updates a record rather than duplicating it."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:IntervalRecord ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:recordOwner a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "record owner"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The accountable owner of this record — a role or team, not a person. Named in every answer that rests on it, so the reader knows who to defer to."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:IntervalRecord ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:recordStatus a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "record status"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Lifecycle state: open | assigned | done | cancelled | detected | resolved."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:IntervalRecord ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:recordVersion a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "record version"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The version or revision this fact was read from. Without it a superseded record and its replacement are indistinguishable in the evidence record, and an answer cannot be reproduced against what it actually used."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:IntervalRecord ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:recoveryMinutes a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "recovery minutes"@en ;
rdfs:comment "How long after a full session the room's conditions return to their normal range. The field that makes 'did the previous class leave too little recovery time before mine?' a calculation against the timetable rather than a guess."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:WorkspaceProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
ontosage:registrationPolicy a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "registration policy"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:PublicEvent ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:relatedTopic a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "related topic"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Links a capability to a related capability/topic (e.g. a broken-lift issue relates to the lift amenity)."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Capability ;
rdfs:range ontosage:Capability ;
skos:example "bldg:Issue_BrokenLift ontosage:relatedTopic bldg:Lift_Main ." .
ontosage:releaseMechanism a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "release mechanism"@en ;
rdfs:comment "How the opening is released in an emergency: break-glass, push pad, fire-panel signal, or manual key override."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:DoorHardware ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:remainingLifeYears a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "remaining life (years)"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Expected remaining life at the survey date, in years. An ESTIMATE by the surveyor, so an answer using it is calculated, never observed. ZERO OR LESS means the asset is at or beyond its expected life: a question about assets beyond expected life must use <= 0, not = 0, or an asset already past its life is left out of its own answer."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ConditionSurvey ;
rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
ontosage:replaceability a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "replaceability"@en ;
rdfs:comment "stock item, long lead or irreplaceable. An insurer's concentration question is about this, not about value alone."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AssetEngineeringProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:reportPriority a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "report priority"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Triage priority. Values: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, URGENT (mirrors ontosage:priority on the related maintenance issue)."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Report ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"URGENT\"" .
ontosage:reportStatus a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "report status"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Triage state of a report. Values: NEW, ACKNOWLEDGED, IN_PROGRESS, RESOLVED, CLOSED."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Report ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"NEW\"" .
ontosage:reportTo a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "report to"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Where or to whom a maintenance issue / procedure should be reported."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:KnowledgeTopic ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"Estates FM helpdesk (estates@example.ac.uk / 029 2087 6026); out-of-hours 029 2087 5555\"" .
ontosage:reportedByRole a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "reported by role"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The stakeholder role that filed the report (Module C). Advisory context, not identity."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Report ;
rdfs:range ontosage:StakeholderRole ;
skos:example "bldg:Report_042 ontosage:reportedByRole ontosage:Role_Occupant ." .
ontosage:reportingMonth a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "reporting month"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The calendar month a return covers, as year-month. The join key for 'last month' and 'August'."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:WasteReturn ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:requestChannel a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "request channel"@en ;
rdfs:comment "How a request reaches this department — helpdesk queue, phone, form or duty line."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Department ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:requiredQualification a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "required qualification"@en ;
rdfs:comment "What an officer must hold to work this point. Role-level, never a person."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:resolutionTier a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "resolution tier"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Serialized 'recencyMinutes:maxResolutionSeconds' pairs; finer data for recent windows, coarser for history."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AccessPolicy ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:respondsWithinHours a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "responds within hours"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Agreed target response time in hours for a routine request. Recorded so 'is this overdue?' is a computation rather than an opinion."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Department ;
rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
ontosage:responsibleRole a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "responsible role"@en ;
rdfs:comment "A ROLE name, never a person identifier (privacy by design)."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:IntervalRecord ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:retrievedAt a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "retrieved at"@en ;
rdfs:comment "When the service obtained the record. The THIRD time, kept separate from effectiveFrom (when it applies) and statusObservedAt (when it was observed). Retrieval time never substitutes for either — a record fetched now may have taken effect last year or take effect next Monday."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:IntervalRecord ;
rdfs:range xsd:dateTime .
ontosage:reviewDue a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "review due"@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:date .
ontosage:rideThroughMinutes a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "ride-through minutes"@en ;
rdfs:comment "How long the service keeps running on its own before the alternative has to carry it — UPS autonomy, buffer tank, batch queue."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ContinuityProvision ;
rdfs:range xsd:integer .
ontosage:routeDistanceMetres a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "route distance in metres"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AccessibleRoute ;
rdfs:range xsd:integer .
ontosage:routeFrom a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "route from"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AccessibleRoute ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:routeFromSpace a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "route from space"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The space a route record starts from, where its ontosage:routeFrom text names exactly one space of the building. A starting point outside the building has no link."@en ;
rdfs:range brick:Location .
ontosage:routeTo a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "route to"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AccessibleRoute ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:routeToSpace a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "route to space"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The space a route record ends at, where its ontosage:routeTo text names exactly one space of the building."@en ;
rdfs:range brick:Location .
ontosage:samplingIntervalS a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "sampling interval (s)"@en ;
rdfs:comment "How often the device physically measures. First of the three clocks; distinct from how often it transmits and from what is archived."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:integer .
ontosage:scheduleKind a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "schedule kind"@en ;
rdfs:comment "cleaning | waste_collection | planned_maintenance | planned_shutdown | inspection."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ServiceSchedule ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:scopeSpaces a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "space scope"@en ;
rdfs:comment "own | public | any."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AccessPolicy ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:seasonalChangeover a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "seasonal changeover"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:OperatingRegime ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:seatCount a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "seat count"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Working seats, which is not the fire capacity and not the teaching capacity."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:WorkspaceProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:integer .
ontosage:seatedRests a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "seated rests"@en ;
rdfs:comment "How many places to sit along the route. Asked directly by visitors who need regular rests."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AccessibleRoute ;
rdfs:range xsd:integer .
ontosage:sensoryLevel a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "sensory level"@en ;
rdfs:comment "How busy and stimulating the route is, so a lower-stimulation arrival can be offered."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:servedByDepartment a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "served by department"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The department code that owns this group's requests. Joins a stakeholder question to a contact route and a response target."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:StakeholderGroup ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:servedByLift a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "served by lift"@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:servedByPoint a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "served by point"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The point whose readings represent this zone. Usually located in one of the served spaces, but it may sit in a duct or plenum — which is why ontosage:environmentalBoundary exists alongside containment."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ServedZone ;
rdfs:range brick:Point .
ontosage:servesArea a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "serves area"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The part of the building this asset serves, which is distinct from where it SITS. An AHU in a ground-floor plant room serving Level 3 is the ordinary case, and conflating the two sends an engineer to the wrong floor."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AssetEngineeringProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:servesAreaSpace a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "serves area space"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The space an asset serves, where its ontosage:servesArea text names exactly one space. A served area described as several spaces or a whole floor has no link: picking one of them would claim a service relation nobody recorded."@en ;
rdfs:range brick:Location .
ontosage:servesFloor a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "serves floor"@en ;
rdfs:comment "A brick:Floor a capability serves (e.g. the floors a lift reaches)."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Capability ;
rdfs:range brick:Floor ;
skos:example "bldg:Lift_Main ontosage:servesFloor bldg:Floor_3 ." ;
skos:relatedMatch bot:hasStorey .
ontosage:servesService a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "service"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The service this row is about, in the words the people who run it use."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ContinuityProvision ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:servesSpace a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "serves space"@en ;
rdfs:comment "A space this zone genuinely represents. Asserted from the mechanical design or a commissioning survey — never derived from adjacency, floor membership or distance."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ServedZone ;
rdfs:range brick:Location .
ontosage:serviceFrequency a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "service frequency"@en ;
rdfs:comment "How often a recurring task falls due, in the register's own words."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:serviceScope a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "service scope"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The assets, spaces or activities this department is accountable for. The field a 'who owns this?' question is answered from."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Department ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:serviceStatus a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "current service status"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Convenience link from an asset to its newest AssetStatus record. The records remain the source of truth — this is a shortcut for the common 'is it working now' query, not a replacement for the history."@en ;
rdfs:range ontosage:AssetStatus .
ontosage:servicesInVoid a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "services in void"@en ;
rdfs:comment "What runs in the ceiling, riser or floor void at this asset, graded confirmed, probable or unknown. Before intrusive work the grade matters more than the list."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AssetEngineeringProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:sessionKind a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "session kind"@en ;
rdfs:comment "lecture | seminar | lab | exam | event | meeting."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:TimetabledSession ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:setupMinutes a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "setup minutes"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Time needed in the room before a session can start — logging in, connecting, arranging. Separate from travel because they are paid by different people at different moments, and a transition that fits the travel can still fail on the setup."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:WorkspaceProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
ontosage:shiftName a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "shift"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The working period that owns a task."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:skillMeasuredAt a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "skill measured at"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ForecastSkill ;
rdfs:range xsd:dateTime .
ontosage:skillOf a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "skill of modality"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ForecastSkill ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:spendCategory a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "spend category"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Planned, reactive, statutory, contract-fixed or demand-led. Asked directly: what proportion of spend is each."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:CostLine ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:stakeholderCategory a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "stakeholder category"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Broad family: occupant, operations, specialist, external, governance or visitor. Used to answer 'which groups are affected' without enumerating every row."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:StakeholderGroup ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:standingCharge a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "standing charge"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Fixed daily charge, independent of consumption."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Tariff ;
rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
ontosage:startsAt a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "starts at"@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:statusObservedAt a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "status observed at"@en ;
rdfs:comment "When the issuing source last confirmed this state. A three-week-old 'operational' is not current status, and the freshness gate judges it exactly as it judges a sensor reading."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AssetStatus ;
rdfs:range xsd:dateTime .
ontosage:statusOf a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "status of"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The asset, amenity or service this record describes."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AssetStatus .
ontosage:statusSource a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "issuing source"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The authoritative system or role that reported this state. Recorded because OntoSage requires source authority on every consequential answer, and because a status with no traceable issuer cannot be relied on for a safety-adjacent decision."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AssetStatus ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"lift_controller\" | \"estates_helpdesk\" | \"av_support\"" .
ontosage:statusValue a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "status value"@en ;
rdfs:comment "operational | degraded | out_of_service | unverified. UNVERIFIED is the default for anything no authoritative source has reported, and is deliberately NOT the same as operational: 'nobody has told me it is broken' is not evidence that it works, and answering as though it were is how a step-free route gets recommended through a failed lift."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AssetStatus ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"out_of_service\"" .
ontosage:stepFreeMinutes a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "step-free minutes"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The same journey using the lift, INCLUDING typical wait. Longer than the walking time on most floor pairs, which is the point: a step-free route is not the walking route with a lift substituted, and planning a transition on the walking figure sends a wheelchair user late."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:CirculationTime ;
rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
ontosage:steps a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "how-to steps"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Ordered steps for a Procedure, separated by semicolons; OntoSage renders them as a numbered list."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Procedure ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"Note the room and floor; Email the helpdesk or call; Use the app for urgent issues\"" .
ontosage:stockCategory a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "stock category"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The trade or service the item supports: cleaning, waste, HVAC, controls, lighting, audio-visual, IT, reception or furniture."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:StockItem ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:stockKind a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "stock kind"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Consumable, spare, loan or surplus. Kept as its own field because 'are we running low' means something different for each: a consumable is reordered, a spare is held against an asset, a loan line is about availability, and surplus has no minimum."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:StockItem ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:stockUnit a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "stock unit"@en ;
rdfs:comment "What one counted unit is: cartridges, cases, sets, receivers. A quantity without its unit cannot be compared with a delivery."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:StockItem ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:streamCapacityLitres a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "stream capacity (L)"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Nominal capacity of this point for this stream. Needed to turn a fill-level percentage into anything actionable: 80% of a 25 L office bin and 80% of a 1100 L euro-bin are different problems."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:WastePoint ;
rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
ontosage:suitableForCalls a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "suitable for calls"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Whether a video or confidential call can be taken here without disturbing others or being overheard. Requires acoustic separation, not merely a door."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:WorkspaceProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:boolean .
ontosage:supersedes a owl:ObjectProperty ;
rdfs:label "supersedes"@en ;
rdfs:comment "This record replaces an earlier one. Both are retained: conflicting originals are preserved for the accountable owner rather than silently resolved."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:IntervalRecord ;
rdfs:range ontosage:IntervalRecord .
ontosage:supportsFormat a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "supports format"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Which teaching formats this component serves -- lecture, seminar, hybrid, practical."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:surveyedBy a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "surveyed by"@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:surveyedOn a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "surveyed on"@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:date .
ontosage:systemState a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "system state"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Ready, degraded or unavailable. Degraded is recorded rather than rounded to either neighbour, because it changes which fallback applies."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:tagInBMS a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "tag in BMS"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AssetEngineeringProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:tagInMaintenance a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "tag in maintenance system"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Held as three SEPARATE tag fields, not one identifier, for the same reason the waste register separates label from signage: 'are asset names consistent across drawings, BMS and maintenance records?' is only answerable if the disagreement can be represented."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AssetEngineeringProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:tagOnDrawings a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "tag on drawings"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AssetEngineeringProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:targetAuthority a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "target authority"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Who set the target and stands behind it. Required for the same reason a potability statement needs an owner: an unattributed commitment cannot be relied on, and cannot be challenged."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:SustainabilityTarget ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:targetBaselinePeriod a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "baseline period"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The period the target is measured against. A 20% reduction is meaningless without it, and choosing a baseline after the fact is the oldest way to make a number say what you want."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:SustainabilityTarget ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:targetDate a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "target date"@en ;
rdfs:comment "When the target is to be met. Progress against an undated target cannot be judged, because 'on track' is a statement about a rate, not a level."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:SustainabilityTarget ;
rdfs:range xsd:date .
ontosage:targetMetric a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "target metric"@en ;
rdfs:comment "What is being targeted, in the same terms the measurement uses: diversion_rate | carbon_intensity | energy_intensity | water_per_capita | waste_per_capita."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:SustainabilityTarget ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:targetUnit a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "target unit"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Unit of the target value. Required: a diversion target of 65 means nothing without knowing whether that is a percentage or a tonnage."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:SustainabilityTarget ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:targetValue a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "target value"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:SustainabilityTarget ;
rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
ontosage:testStandard a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "test standard"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The standard or regime the asset is held to, so 'is this compliant?' has a stated benchmark rather than an opinion."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:FireSafetyAsset ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:timeProfile a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "time profile"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AccessPermission ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:toFloor a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "to floor"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:CirculationTime ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:transmissionIntervalS a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "transmission interval (s)"@en ;
rdfs:comment "How often the device reports. Second of the three clocks. This is what a freshness gate must judge against: a point transmitting every 15 minutes is not stale at 10."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:integer .
ontosage:treatmentRoute a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "treatment route"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Where the stream goes: energy from waste, materials recovery, paper mill, anaerobic digestion, WEEE recycler."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:WasteReturn ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:typicalDecimals a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "typical decimals"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Decimal places a reading of this quantity is meaningfully reported to. A fallback: the storage column's own scale wins where the schema knows it, because writing 0.25 into an integer column stores 0 and that is how a correct range still yields an incorrect reading."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Measurand .
ontosage:typicalMax a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "typical maximum"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The high end of the ordinary operating range. See typicalMin: descriptive, never a filter."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Measurand .
ontosage:typicalMin a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "typical minimum"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The low end of the ordinary operating range. Used to GENERATE synthetic streams and to describe what is normal. NEVER used to reject a reading -- that is physicalMin's job, and confusing the two suppresses the readings that matter most."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Measurand .
ontosage:unitRate a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "unit rate"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Cost per unit (per kWh, per cubic metre). Only ever read from a registered Tariff — never defaulted, never assumed."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Tariff ;
rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
ontosage:unoccupiedSetpoint a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "unoccupied setpoint"@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:OperatingRegime ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:usageFee a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "usage fee"@en ;
rdfs:comment "What it costs to use an amenity, in the building's own words: 'free', 'GBP 2.50 per day'. ABSENT MEANS NOT RECORDED, which is a different fact from free -- an answer must never turn an empty field into 'it is free'."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Capability ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"free for card holders; visitors GBP 3 per day\"" .
ontosage:usedFor a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "used for"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The asset, system or task the stock supports, by the name the asset register or service schedule uses."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:StockItem ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:utilityKind a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "utility"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Electricity, gas, water, heat."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:Tariff ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:valueBand a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "value band"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Replacement value band. A band rather than a figure, because a precise figure implies a valuation nobody has done."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:AssetEngineeringProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:varianceCause a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "variance cause"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Price, quantity, timing or scope. Recorded, because the movement alone cannot say which and the remedies differ."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:CostLine ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:visitorEntrance a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "visitor entrance"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The entrance a visitor should use, which is not always the one nearest the venue."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:PublicEvent ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:walkingMinutes a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "walking minutes"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Typical time by stairs at an unhurried pace, between the usual teaching spaces on each floor."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:CirculationTime ;
rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
ontosage:wasteStation a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "waste station"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The grouping of bins a user meets together. Conflicts are judged WITHIN a station, because that is where somebody stands and chooses."@en ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:wasteStream a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "recorded waste stream"@en,
"waste stream"@en ;
rdfs:comment "What the system says the point is for."@en,
"general | mixed_recycling | paper | glass | food | WEEE | confidential | batteries. A point may declare several. The stream is what makes a contamination ratio meaningful: without knowing which stream a measurement belongs to, two numbers cannot be compared."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:WastePoint ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"mixed_recycling\"" .
ontosage:wasteTonnes a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "waste tonnes"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The weight collected in the month, in tonnes. Absent while the return is pending: a blank is the finding, not a zero."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:WasteReturn ;
rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
ontosage:weighingMethod a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "weighing method"@en ;
rdfs:comment "How the weight was obtained: bin-lift scale, weighbridge ticket, delivery note, or estimated from container volume. An estimate is reported as one."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:WasteReturn ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:workspaceKind a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "workspace kind"@en ;
rdfs:comment "quiet study, open study, group study, bookable room, teaching room, computer lab, common room or breakout."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:WorkspaceProfile ;
rdfs:range xsd:string .
ontosage:zoneId a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "zone id"@en ;
rdfs:comment "The canonical zone identifier a space carries in the building's floor-plan manifests (DWG/PDF pipeline). This literal is THE join key between a manifest Space and its ontology individual — label-based joins break on decorated labels ('HVAC Zone 5.28'@en) and non-dotted CAD ids ('3Z001'), so generators emit this instead and the manifest linker matches on it first."@en ;
rdfs:domain brick:Location ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "bldg:Room_5.28 ontosage:zoneId \"5.28\" ." .
ontosage:zoneValidated a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "zone validated"@en ;
rdfs:comment "True only when the serving relation has been checked against the mechanical design or a commissioning survey. ABSENT OR FALSE MEANS THE ZONE DOES NOT COUNT: the spatial-adequacy gate treats an unvalidated zone as proxy evidence, so it can be reported as context but can never carry a room-level claim. Fail-closed on purpose — an unvalidated zone that were trusted is a silent substitution."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ServedZone ;
rdfs:range xsd:boolean .
ontosage:zoneValidatedOn a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "zone validated on"@en ;
rdfs:comment "When the serving relation was last verified. A zone validated against a mechanical schedule from before a refurbishment describes a building that no longer exists."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ServedZone ;
rdfs:range xsd:date .
ontosage:zoneValidationMethod a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
rdfs:label "zone validation method"@en ;
rdfs:comment "How the serving relation was established: mechanical_schedule | commissioning_survey | tracer_test | as_built_drawing. Recorded because 'validated' means little without saying against what — and because a tracer test and a drawing are not equally strong evidence."@en ;
rdfs:domain ontosage:ServedZone ;
rdfs:range xsd:string ;
skos:example "\"commissioning_survey\"" .
<http://ontosage.org/ontology> a owl:Ontology ;
rdfs:label "OntoSage Conversational Building Vocabulary (OCBV)"@en ;
dcterms:conformsTo sosa:,
<https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick>,
<https://w3id.org/bot>,
<https://w3id.org/rec> ;
dcterms:created "2026-07-15"^^xsd:date ;
dcterms:creator "OntoSage" ;
dcterms:description """A stakeholder-facing conversational extension of the Brick Schema. OCBV
adds the vocabulary a building needs to answer natural-language questions from occupants,
visitors, facilities managers, researchers, and other stakeholders: physical amenities and
services, informational facts, how-to procedures, maintenance-issue reporting routes, the
lay-language ⇄ sensor concepts occupants use ("stuffy" → CO₂), the stakeholder roles who ask,
the kinds of question they ask, and the provenance that grounds each answer. Everything is
expressed as SPARQL-queryable RDF that extends Brick without contradicting it — OCBV terms
live in their own namespaces and reference Brick entities rather than redefining them."""@en ;
dcterms:license <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/> ;
dcterms:modified "2026-07-17"^^xsd:date ;
dcterms:title "OntoSage Conversational Building Vocabulary (OCBV)"@en ;
vann:preferredNamespacePrefix "ontosage" ;
vann:preferredNamespaceUri "http://ontosage.org/capabilities#" ;
rdfs:comment """OCBV is additive to Brick. It declares only ontosage: and hbco: terms and never
alters the meaning of any brick: term; where it touches the physical building it references
Brick classes as property ranges and aligns to external standards with SKOS mapping
properties only. Load it alongside a Brick model to make that building answerable in plain
language. v2.0.0 consolidates the former OCBV capability schema and the HBCO conversation
ontology into this single file and adds stakeholder-role and standards-alignment modules."""@en ;
rdfs:seeAlso ontosage:Capability,
sosa:,
<https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick>,
<https://w3id.org/bot>,
<https://w3id.org/rec> ;

ontosage:EventActivity a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Event activity"@en ;
ontosage:layTerms "agenda",
"breakout session",
"breakout sessions",
"event activities",
"event activity",
"event program",
"event programme",
"event session",
"event sessions",
"how long will",
"how much time",
"itinerary",
"schedule of the day",
"talk",
"tour",
"what should we prioritise",
"workshop" ;
rdfs:comment "One item inside a PublicEvent's agenda: its position, start, duration, location, whether a companion may attend and whether it is optional. An agenda is not a property of an event -- it is a sequence of things with their own durations and rules, which is why it is rows. companionPolicy is per ACTIVITY because a campus tour and a one-to-one admissions conversation can sit inside the same open day and differ, and a family planning their day needs it at that level or the answer is wrong for half the visit. isOptional exists so 'we only have two hours, what should we prioritise' is answerable by dropping what the events office marked optional rather than by inventing a preference."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf ontosage:Record ;
skos:example "how much time for the talk, tour and questions? -> EventActivity where partOfEvent matches; sum expectedMinutes." .

"permit",
"permit to work",
"permits",
"ptw",
"roof access permit",
"work authorisation" ;
rdfs:comment "An authorisation to carry out controlled work (hot works, roof access, confined space, electrical isolation) for a bounded period in a bounded place. Open or closed is READ from recordStatus, never inferred from the dates: a permit past its end date that was never closed is an exception worth reporting, not a closed permit."@en ;

ontosage:AVReadiness a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Teaching AV readiness"@en ;
ontosage:layTerms "amplifier",
"audio path",
"audio visual",
"audiovisual",
"av",
"av check",
"av evidence",
"av readiness",
"camera",
"confirmed readiness",
"display",
"hearing loop",
"is the room ready",
"microphone",
"projector",
"readiness for the next",
"room ready for teaching",
"teaching room ready" ;
rdfs:comment "One audiovisual component in a teaching room, with its state, the formats it serves, when it was last checked and the evidence reference for that check. THE AUDIO PATH IS A CHAIN: a room with a working projector, a working display and a dead microphone cannot run a lecture that needs amplification, so inAudioPath marks the links and a room's readiness for a format follows from the chain rather than from one asserted flag. No component may be recorded READY without evidence -- 'checked' without a record is a claim, and withholding a room from service on somebody's recollection is what the team is trying to avoid. The rule is conditional rather than a required column, because a component that has NEVER been tested has no check date and no reference, and that is the most important row in the register rather than one to exclude: `unevidenced` exists so it can be stated."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf ontosage:Record ;
skos:example "which rooms have complete current AV evidence for a lecture? -> AVReadiness grouped by locationText where supportsFormat names the format; a room fails if any inAudioPath component is not ready." .

ontosage:MaintenanceIssue a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Maintenance / fault issue"@en ;
ontosage:competencyQuestion "The toilet is leaking — who do I tell, and how urgent is it?" ;
ontosage:exampleSparql """
# Match a stated fault to its issue and return the report route + priority.
SELECT ?issue ?reportTo ?priority WHERE {
?issue a ontosage:MaintenanceIssue ; ontosage:layTerms ?lt .
OPTIONAL { ?issue ontosage:reportTo ?reportTo }
OPTIONAL { ?issue ontosage:priority ?priority }
FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?lt), "leak"))
} LIMIT 1""" ;
rdfs:comment "A fault type and who to report it to: leak, broken light, broken lift, heating fault. MAY reference the brick:Equipment it concerns via ontosage:aboutEquipment."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf ontosage:KnowledgeTopic ;
skos:example "\"there is a water leak\" -> the leak maintenance issue (report route = Estates)." .

rdfs:comment "One line of the waste contractor's monthly return: the weight collected from the building in one month for one stream, how it was weighed, how it was treated and what share of it was diverted from landfill. TONNES, NOT BINS: the collection point register records containers and their fill percentage, which is not a weight. A MONTH IS NOT A FIGURE UNTIL ITS RETURN IS ISSUED -- the current month is held as pending with no weight, so a question about this month has no issued answer and the honest reply is the latest complete month, dated. HOW A WEIGHT WAS OBTAINED MATTERS: a weight estimated from container volume is an estimate and must be reported as one. The building's diverted share is weighted by tonnage, never the average of the stream percentages. Weights are for the whole building: nothing here is per floor, per room or per day."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf ontosage:IntervalRecord ;
skos:example "how much waste did we produce last month? -> WasteReturn where reportingMonth is the latest month whose status is not pending; sum wasteTonnes across streams." .

rdfs:comment "A SURVEYED journey between an arrival point and a destination, carrying the facts a disabled visitor actually asks for: entrance, step-free or not, seated rests, how the doors operate, which lift and whether it is in service, how much time to allow, how busy it is, and a non-telephone assistance contact. surveyedOn and surveyedBy are required because every question this answers uses the word 'verified' — a route inferred from geometry is a guess about somebody's journey, and a wrong guess costs them the journey. DISTINCT FROM ontosage:StakeholderRole, which is a conversational persona that biases answer framing: this is operational data about a group, with an owner and effective dates, and it is a Record for that reason. No individual is modelled — a group is the finest grain this register goes to."@en ;

rdfs:comment "One line of the building's ledger, carrying budget, actual, committed and accrued as SEPARATE amounts. Free balance is budget minus all three, and a register that folded commitments into actuals could report money as available when a purchase order has already claimed it -- 'decision-ready free balance' is precisely the figure after all three. varianceCause is recorded rather than inferred, because a line can move on price, quantity, timing or scope and the number alone cannot say which, while the remedies differ."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf ontosage:Record ;
skos:example "what is the decision-ready free balance? -> sum(budgetAmount) - sum(actualAmount) - sum(committedAmount) - sum(accruedAmount) over the period." .

rdfs:label "Stock item"@en ;

"running low on",

"surplus items",

"toilet rolls",
"toilet tissue",
"washroom supplies",
"what spares",
"which spares" ;
rdfs:comment "One stock line: a kind of item held in one store, with the quantity on hand, the level below which it is reordered, who is accountable for it and when it was last counted. FOUR KINDS ARE KEPT APART because they answer different questions: a consumable is used up, a spare is held against a named asset, loan equipment is lent and returned, and surplus is withdrawn stock available for reuse. Quantity on hand is what is on the shelf now -- anything out on loan is stated in the note and never counted as stock, and a loan line never says who has an item. STATUS FOLLOWS THE NUMBERS: a line is in stock only when quantity on hand is at or above its minimum, so a shortage is a comparison the reader can check rather than an adjective. Safety-critical stock (fire extinguishers, emergency lighting parts, first-aid supplies, hazardous chemicals) is deliberately not held here."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf ontosage:Record ;
skos:example "which consumables are running low? -> StockItem where stockKind = consumable and quantityOnHand < minimumLevel; read nextDue for the delivery or reorder date." .
ontosage:SourceType a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Answer source type"@en ;
rdfs:comment "A kind of system an OntoSage answer can be grounded in. An answer records which source type(s) produced it, so it is auditable and never a plausible-but-unsourced guess."@en ;
skos:definition "A category of grounding source for an answer (graph, time-series DB, floor plan, analytics, …)."@en ;
skos:example "A trend answer is grounded in Src_TimeSeriesDB + Src_Analytics." .
ontosage:Report a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Report"@en ;
rdfs:comment "A stakeholder-submitted statement about the building requiring action or acknowledgement: a fault, complaint, safety concern, feedback, or suggestion. Created from a Module D Intent_Report utterance."@en ;
skos:definition "A submitted fault/complaint/safety/feedback/suggestion record."@en ;
skos:example "\"the toilet on floor 2 is leaking\" -> an ontosage:FaultReport." .
ontosage:QuestionIntent a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Question intent"@en ;
ontosage:competencyQuestion "What kind of question is this, and how should it be answered?" ;
ontosage:exampleSparql """
# Given cue words, find the matching intent and its answering source types.
SELECT ?intent ?label (GROUP_CONCAT(?src; separator=", ") AS ?sources) WHERE {
?intent a ontosage:QuestionIntent ; rdfs:label ?label ; ontosage:intentPattern ?pat .
OPTIONAL { ?intent ontosage:answeredBy ?s . ?s rdfs:label ?src }
FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?pat), "how many"))
} GROUP BY ?intent ?label""" ;
rdfs:comment "A kind of question a stakeholder can ask, independent of the specific building. Classifying an utterance to an intent selects the answering strategy (fact lookup vs computation vs time-series vs report)."@en ;
skos:definition "The shape/kind of a stakeholder question (locate, quantify, trend, compare, …)."@en ;
skos:example "\"how many CO₂ sensors are there?\" -> ontosage:Intent_Quantify." .
ontosage:StakeholderRole a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Stakeholder role"@en ;
ontosage:competencyQuestion "For this role, how deep should the answer be and what do they care about?" ;
ontosage:exampleSparql """
SELECT ?role ?depth (GROUP_CONCAT(?cat; separator=", ") AS ?cats) WHERE {
?role a ontosage:StakeholderRole ; ontosage:defaultPersonaDepth ?depth .
OPTIONAL { ?role ontosage:asksAbout ?c . ?c skos:prefLabel ?cat }
} GROUP BY ?role ?depth""" ;
rdfs:comment "A conversational persona OntoSage serves. Roles bias answer framing (depth, tone) and the capability categories surfaced first — they are NOT RBAC permissions. One natural-language interface serves every role."@en ;
skos:definition "A category of building stakeholder, used only to frame and prioritise answers (not for access control)."@en ;
skos:example "An Occupant asking 'is it stuffy?' gets a plain answer; a FacilityManager gets the CO₂ figure + trend." .
ontosage:KnowledgeTopic a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Knowledge topic"@en ;
rdfs:comment "A non-physical capability: an informational fact, a how-to procedure, or a maintenance-issue reporting route. Answered from its ontosage:answerText plus contacts/steps — this is what lets policy/how-to/report questions be answered from triples instead of frozen prose."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf ontosage:Capability ;
skos:definition "An informational, procedural, or maintenance topic a stakeholder can ask about."@en .
ontosage:Capability a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Capability"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Abstract superclass of everything a building stakeholder can ask OntoSage about that Brick does not already model — a physical amenity or a knowledge topic."@en ;
skos:definition "Anything a stakeholder can ask a building about via OntoSage."@en .

ontosage:Amenity a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Amenity"@en ;
ontosage:competencyQuestion "What amenities are on floor 1?",
"Where is the prayer room / café / nearest lift?" ;
ontosage:exampleSparql """
# "where can I pray?" — match lay terms, return the human location.
SELECT ?amenity ?label ?where WHERE {
?amenity a ontosage:Amenity ;
ontosage:layTerms ?lt ;
rdfs:label ?label .
OPTIONAL { ?amenity ontosage:locationText ?where }
FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?lt), "pray"))
} LIMIT 5""" ;
rdfs:comment "A physical facility or service a stakeholder can locate and use (prayer room, café, lift, showers, …). Distinct from a brick:Point/brick:Equipment: it is described for humans, and MAY be tied to a brick:Location via ontosage:locatedIn."@en ;
rdfs:subClassOf ontosage:Capability ;
skos:definition "A physical building facility or service with a human-readable location and features."@en ;
skos:example "A multi-faith prayer room on Floor 1; the main passenger lift; the ground-floor café." .
ontosage:Record a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Record"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Abstract supertype for a standing record a building keeps about itself: a register row such as a fire-safety asset, a department, a workspace profile or a sustainability target. It has an owner, a status and a version rather than an interval lifecycle. Never instantiated directly."@en .
ontosage:Measurand a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Measurand"@en ;
rdfs:comment "A quantity a sensor can measure, at the granularity that distinguishes one gas from another. QUDT stops at VolumeFraction, which cannot tell CO from NO2 - so these are declared here rather than borrowed."@en .
ontosage:IntervalRecord a owl:Class ;
rdfs:label "Interval record"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Abstract supertype for anything that happens over a time interval with a lifecycle: bookings, work orders, access events, alarms, compliance checks, anomaly episodes. Never instantiated directly."@en .

  • dcterms:description "A stakeholder-facing conversational extension of the Brick Schema. OCBV\n adds the vocabulary a building needs to answer natural-language questions from occupants,\n visitors, facilities managers, researchers, and other stakeholders: physical amenities and\n services, informational facts, how-to procedures, maintenance-issue reporting routes, the\n lay-language \u21c4 sensor concepts occupants use (\"stuffy\" \u2192 CO\u2082), the stakeholder roles who ask,\n the kinds of question they ask, and the provenance that grounds each answer. Everything is\n expressed as SPARQL-queryable RDF that extends Brick without contradicting it \u2014 OCBV terms\n live in their own namespaces and reference Brick entities rather than redefining them."@en [from <http://ontosage.org/ontology>:2722:25]

  • rdfs:comment "OCBV is additive to Brick. It declares only ontosage: and hbco: terms and never\n alters the meaning of any brick: term; where it touches the physical building it references\n Brick classes as property ranges and aligns to external standards with SKOS mapping\n properties only. Load it alongside a Brick model to make that building answerable in plain\n language. v2.0.0 consolidates the former OCBV capability schema and the HBCO conversation\n ontology into this single file and adds stakeholder-role and standards-alignment modules."@en [from <http://ontosage.org/ontology>:2735:18]

About this explorer

These pages are generated from the OntoSage schema files (ontology/ on GitHub). Only schema-level content is published: classes, properties, concepts and controlled vocabularies. No building's rooms, sensors or readings are included.

The Brick terms shown are an excerpt: only the Brick classes and properties OntoSage names, with their superclasses. The complete Brick ontology is at ontology.brickschema.org.

The tree and the class summaries are inferred from the Turtle by rdf-toolkit (MIT licence). Check a definition against the Turtle before relying on it. Search runs in your browser; nothing you type is sent anywhere.

Report a problem

Open an issue in the OntoSage repository and name the term.
